t: How to get buy-in for changes to your organizational structure
s: April 29, 2020 - Becoming distributed: Transitioning to a remote or distributed company may result in organizational changes. As you plan, indicate the physical location of people in your organization on your org chart. After establishing the current state of your org, you can share the new organizational design. Make the proposed adjustments to your org chart, and show the current and future states back to back so leadership can clearly see what will be different.
